representation.shell_command:

import csv
import itertools
import math
import statistics
import sys
import zipfile
from io import StringIO
import Bio
from Bio import Phylo

sources = [("animals", sys.argv[1]), ("fungi", sys.argv[2])]
rows = []
summary = [("biopython_version", Bio.__version__)]
medians = {}

for group, path in sources:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        names = sorted(n for n in archive.namelist() if n.endswith(".treefile") and not n.endswith("/"))
        if not names:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{group}: no .treefile members found")
        values = []
        for name in names:
            tree_text = archive.read(name).decode("utf-8").strip()
            tree = Phylo.read(StringIO(tree_text), "newick")
            tips = tree.get_terminals()
            tip_names = [tip.name for tip in tips]
            if len(tips) < 2:
                raise RuntimeError(f"{group}/{name}: fewer than two tips")
            if any(x is None or x == "" for x in tip_names) or len(set(tip_names)) != len(tip_names):
                raise RuntimeError(f"{group}/{name}: missing or duplicate tip names")
            missing = [clade for clade in tree.find_clades() if clade is not tree.root and clade.branch_length is None]
            if missing:
                raise RuntimeError(f"{group}/{name}: missing branch length")
            distances = [tree.distance(a, b) for a, b in itertools.combinations(tips, 2)]
            if not distances or any(not math.isfinite(x) or x < -1e-12 for x in distances):
                raise RuntimeError(f"{group}/{name}: invalid patristic distance")
            mean_distance = statistics.fmean(distances)
            values.append(mean_distance)
            rows.append((group, name, len(tips), len(distances), format(mean_distance, ".17g")))
        medians[group] = statistics.median(values)
        summary.extend([
            (f"{group}_selected_treefiles", str(len(names))),
            (f"{group}_processed_treefiles", str(len(values))),
            (f"{group}_median_mean_patristic_distance", format(medians[group], ".17g")),
        ])

ratio = medians["fungi"] / medians["animals"]
summary.append(("fungi_over_animals_ratio", format(ratio, ".17g")))

with open("per_tree.tsv", "w", newline="") as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["group", "tree", "n_tips", "n_pairs", "mean_patristic_distance"])
    writer.writerows(rows)

with open("summary.tsv", "w", newline="") as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["metric", "value"])
    writer.writerows(summary)
PY

import csv
import itertools
import math
import statistics
import sys
import zipfile
from io import TextIOWrapper
import Bio
from Bio import Phylo

if Bio.__version__ != "1.84":
    raise RuntimeError("Expected Biopython 1.84, found " + Bio.__version__)

def analyze(group, archive_path):
    rows = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        members = sorted(n for n in archive.namelist() if n.endswith(".treefile") and not n.endswith("/"))
        if not members:
            raise ValueError("No .treefile members found in " + archive_path)
        for member in members:
            with archive.open(member) as raw:
                tree = Phylo.read(TextIOWrapper(raw, encoding="utf-8"), "newick")
            root = tree.root
            for clade in tree.find_clades(order="preorder"):
                if clade is root:
                    continue
                length = clade.branch_length
                if length is None or not math.isfinite(length) or length < 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid branch length in {group}:{member}")
            tips = tree.get_terminals()
            if len(tips) < 2:
                raise ValueError(f"Fewer than two tips in {group}:{member}")
            labels = [tip.name for tip in tips]
            if any(label is None for label in labels) or len(set(labels)) != len(labels):
                raise ValueError(f"Missing or duplicate tip label in {group}:{member}")
            distances = [tree.distance(a, b) for a, b in itertools.combinations(tips, 2)]
            if any(not math.isfinite(x) for x in distances):
                raise ValueError(f"Non-finite patristic distance in {group}:{member}")
            rows.append((group, member, len(tips), len(distances), statistics.fmean(distances)))
    return rows

animals = analyze("animals", sys.argv[1])
fungi = analyze("fungi", sys.argv[2])
with open("per_tree_metrics.tsv", "w", newline="") as out:

    writer.writerow(["group", "member", "n_taxa", "n_pairs", "mean_patristic_distance"])
    for row in animals + fungi:
        writer.writerow([row[0], row[1], row[2], row[3], format(row[4], ".17g")])

animal_median = statistics.median(row[4] for row in animals)
fungal_median = statistics.median(row[4] for row in fungi)
ratio = fungal_median / animal_median
with open("summary.tsv", "w", newline="") as out:
    writer = csv.writer(out, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["animals_n_trees", "fungi_n_trees", "animals_median_mean_patristic_distance", "fungi_median_mean_patristic_distance", "fungi_over_animals_ratio"])

    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        members = sorted(
            name for name in archive.namelist()
            if not name.endswith("/") and name.endswith(".treefile")
        )
        if not members:

            if len(leaves) < 2:

            distances = []
            for i in range(len(leaves)):
